summary: Full backend + frontend validation of iteration-23 work: leaderboard scopes (class/teacher/school/global), non-zero points regression fix, /me/rank-scopes, POST /me/school, and Guide Console by-class Reports / Test Scores / Assignments pickers. Backend: 21/21 pytest passed (new /app/backend/tests/test_rank_scopes.py). Frontend: all requested flows passed with cookie-injected guide (em_guide_tok) and explorer (em_exp_tok) sessions. The original complaint (rankings showing 0) is confirmed FIXED - class/teacher/school scope all report North Star = 100 for Test Class Assign, both in individual rows and Teams standings.

issues: Scope TabsList renders a single lone 'Everybody' pill (expected per spec, but visually looks like a stray button); consider hiding the tab strip entirely when only one scope is available.
Selecting a class with no members renders an empty area with no empty-state copy (just the 'Ranked by Total points' footer). An explicit 'No Explorers in this class yet' message would be clearer.

Email column shows 50% in red for Em Fresh Explorer while the sub-label reads '1/14 mastered' — the red/danger colour applies to the average score, which reads as an error next to a positive mastery count. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: default class ordering. Both the Guide Console ClassPicker and the Leaderboard class select default to the FIRST item of the newest-first expeditions list, i.e. the most recently created class (a freshly created empty class became the default). If the intended default is the primary/first-created class, sort ascending or persist the last selection.
Optional: no DELETE /api/expeditions/{id} endpoint exists (returns 405) — QA had to remove a test class directly in MongoDB. Consider adding a guide-scoped delete/archive.
Optional UI polish items listed under design_issues (empty-state copy, single-tab scope strip).
critical_code_review_comments: GuideConsole.jsx is 837 lines with ~10 tab components in one file — over the 700-line guideline; split ReportsTab / TestScoresTab / AssignmentsTab / QuestionBank into src/pages/guide/*.jsx.

Leaderboard.jsx loadBoard() has no try/catch around api.get('/leaderboard') and the /me/rank-scopes effect has no error handling — a 4xx/5xx leaves the page on the infinite spinner with no error UI (only the finally-less initial effect). Add an error state.

Leaderboard.jsx line 40: for scope 'teacher'/'school' it still sends expedition_id, so the backend derives the guide from the class. Works, but scope=teacher for an explorer in multiple classes silently uses classes[0]; make the intent explicit (send guide_id/school from /me/rank-scopes).
server.py leaderboard(): query['expedition_ids'] = '__none__' sentinel to force an empty result is a hack; prefer returning early with empty entries/fleets.
server.py leaderboard() loads up to 5000 users + 50000 points_events into memory per request; fine at current scale but should move to an aggregation pipeline before real classroom volume.

rca_of_the_issue: Original zeros bug: 'By Territory' ranking counted only legacy CTE quest completions. Current implementation ranks on users.horizon_points (metric 'overall') or summed points_events deltas (metric 'week'), both of which include Skill Studio and Checkpoint awards — verified by the assertion score == horizon_points and by the non-zero 100-point class/teacher/school results.
